A '''herb''' native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]] was used as a natural remedy to a virulent [[Sebiris poison|poison]] produced on the planet. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' acquired some of the herb to treat their [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], when she was afflicted with the poison by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] known as [[the Wraith]].
